# blueprint.yml reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the source. Do not edit by hand: change the code and re-run it. -->

One `blueprint.yml` per drawing. Paths are relative to the file. Unknown keys are an error, so a typo fails the build instead of being ignored.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | path | required | The part to draw: a STEP file (`.step`, `.stp`), or an STL as a fallback (curves then draw as facets; an STL over 100,000 triangles takes a fast mesh path, up to 1,000,000 triangles, with no sections; see the README). | `model: build/dock.step` |
| `output` | path | required | Where to write the sheet, without an extension; one file per entry in `formats`. | `output: docs/images/blueprint_dock` |
| `title` | text | required | The drawing title, in the title block's top row. | `title: U1 TAG CLIP · FINGER DOCK` |
| `drawing_number` | text | "" | DWG NO. field. | `drawing_number: STC-001` |
| `for` | text | "" | FOR field: what the part fits or belongs to. | `for: Snapmaker U1 toolhead, filament slot 1` |
| `material` | text | "" | MATERIAL field. | `material: ABS or PETG. Not PLA.` |
| `source` | text | "" | SOURCE field: the file the model comes from. | `source: u1/u1_parts.py` |
| `drawn_by` | text | "" | DRAWN BY field. | `drawn_by: C. MARSHALL` |
| `company` | text | "" | Name on the approved stamp. No stamp is drawn without one. | `company: Shermer Works` |
| `front` | axis | "+Z" | Model axis pointing at the viewer in the front view: one of +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z. | `front: "+Z"` |
| `up` | axis | "+Y" | Model axis pointing up the page in the front view; must be perpendicular to `front`. | `up: "+Y"` |
| `sheet` | size | "B" | ANSI sheet size: one of B, C. | `sheet: "B"` |
| `formats` | list | [png, svg] | Output formats, any of png, svg, pdf. SVG is the scalable copy; PNG is a preview. | `formats: [svg]` |
| `views` | list | [front, top, right, isometric] | Which views to draw, any of front, top, bottom, left, right, back, isometric. Several keep their third-angle places around the front; one on its own is centred and drawn as large as a standard scale allows. | `views: [top]` |
| `isometric` | number or fill | 1 | Isometric scale as a multiple of the main scale when it sits beside other views, or `fill` to fill the space to their right. | `isometric: 1.6` |
| `captions` | map | {} | Extra caption text per view, shown in brackets after the view name. | `captions: {front: socket face, top: snap fingers up}` |
| `notes` | list | [] | General notes, numbered and wrapped in the lower-left corner. | `notes: [Print flat edge down, no supports.]` |
| `centre_lines` | list | [] | Named axes to draw as chain lines, each `{label, point, axis}` in model coordinates (mm): `point` is any point on the axis, `axis` its direction (any length, not zero). The line runs across every orthographic view where the axis projects to a line, labelled `CL` plus the label. A view looking straight down the axis shows a point, and nothing is drawn there (circles seen face on already get their own centre mark). The isometric carries none. | `centre_lines: [{label: SOCKET AXIS, point: [12, 12, 0], axis: [0, 0, 1]}]` |
| `licence` | SPDX id or map | none | Override for the LICENCE row. Normally omitted: the licence and copyright are read from the repo's REUSE.toml for the drawing's own output file, and a render with no REUSE.toml or no matching annotation fails. Set this (an SPDX id) to skip that lookup. Known ids (CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC-BY-ND-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0, CC0-1.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-3.0-or-later, CERN-OHL-S-2.0) get their label, CC icons or a badge, and deed link; others print as given. Any id containing -NC- adds NOT FOR RESALE unless given `{id: ..., note: ...}`. | `licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0` |
| `copyright` | text | from REUSE.toml | Copyright line for the LICENCE row when `licence:` overrides the REUSE lookup. | `copyright: © 2026 Charles Marshall` |
| `readme` | path | "" | Markdown file to keep the drawing embedded in, between `<!-- blueprint:NAME -->` and `<!-- /blueprint -->` (NAME is the output file name). Each render rewrites the embed and a credit line linking this project. | `readme: README.md` |
| `preview` | true or map | none | Also draw a sheet-free preview for a README header: the part with no border, title block or dimensions, as SVG. `true` draws this model; a map sets `view` (default isometric), `width` (most mm across, default 200; parts stand at most 90 mm tall), `output` (default OUTPUT-preview) and `parts`, a list of `{model, caption}` drawn side by side at one scale (default: this model, uncaptioned). With `readme`, it is kept embedded between `<!-- blueprint-preview:NAME -->` and `<!-- /blueprint-preview -->` (NAME is the preview's output file name). | `preview: {parts: [{model: build/inline.step, caption: IN-LINE}, {model: build/end.step, caption: END}]}` |
| `style` | map | {} | House-style switches: `aged` (default true), `grid` (default false), `stamp` (default true), `winks` (default true), `credit` (default true). | `style: {grid: true, winks: false}` |

## A complete example

```yaml
model: build/dock.step
output: docs/images/blueprint_dock
title: U1 TAG CLIP · FINGER DOCK
drawing_number: STC-001
for: Snapmaker U1 toolhead, filament slot 1
material: ABS or PETG. Not PLA.
source: u1/u1_parts.py
drawn_by: C. MARSHALL
company: Shermer Works
front: "+Z"
up: "+Y"
sheet: "B"
formats: [svg]
views: [top]
isometric: 1.6
captions: {front: socket face, top: snap fingers up}
notes: [Print flat edge down, no supports.]
centre_lines: [{label: SOCKET AXIS, point: [12, 12, 0], axis: [0, 0, 1]}]
licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
copyright: © 2026 Charles Marshall
readme: README.md
preview: {parts: [{model: build/inline.step, caption: IN-LINE}, {model: build/end.step, caption: END}]}
style: {grid: true, winks: false}
```
